decisions.statement: A call naming no performance is refused naming every performance there is.
The `measured` that code exports is what is called.
No ceiling on processor time holds a run here.
A performance is named by its slug rather than by its path.
The code beside a performance page is what runs.
A performance whose code exports no `measured` is refused rather than run.
Nothing here judges a figure against a limit.

definition: the command running one performance and saying what that performance measured
